headline: Sources: Giants to release fan favorite Odell Beckham Jr.
summary: The Giants are releasing veteran wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr., sources told NFL Network.

headline: Source - Bengals cut Ke'Shawn Williams after costly muffed punt
summary: The Cincinnati Bengals cut WR Ke'Shawn Williams after he muffed a punt that eventually led to the Pittsburgh Steelers' 30-27 win, a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler. Earlier Tuesday, Cincinnati signed WR Mitch Tinsley, per ESPN's Adam Schefter.

headline: Sources: Panthers OL Damien Lewis (UCL injury) to miss time
summary: Panthers left guard Damien Lewis has a UCL injury in an elbow and will be out a few weeks, sources told NFL Network's Mike Garafolo and Ian Rapoport.

headline: Giants Among Suitors For Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr.?
summary: On Sunday, the Lions and Cowboys were identified as teams which have made trade inquiries about Joey Porter Jr. The oft-discussed Steelers cornerback appears to be on the radar of at least one other NFC team. The Giants have been mentioned as a candidate for Porter. Art Stapleton of NJ.com notes the “whispers” connecting Porter to New York have “gotten louder” […]

headline: Buccaneers WR Jalen McMillan is expected to miss 6-8 weeks with knee injury
summary: Quarterback Baker Mayfield's dislocated thumb was the headline news for the Buccaneers on the injury front in Week 3, but he isn't the only offensive player set to miss time.

headline: Jerry Jones: 'No explanation' for Cowboys coaches' mistakes
summary: Jerry Jones says he believes errors in game management by his coaching staff cost the Cowboys a victory over the Ravens.
